meta.honorifics: KEEP Japanese honorifics (-chan, -san, -sama, -kun). The game leans on them: 受付ちゃん is the heroine's fan-nickname, and the guest girls are all -chan.
meta.note: Names are hand-locked from the game's own story text (EventData_Event_casino.csv) and the credits/profile panels, not model-inferred. Anything added by a later extract with an empty `en` gets filled by `tl.py run`'s names phase — review those before the text phase.

受付.role: the heroine — reception staff at the casino 'Bunny & Honey', forced by the manager into being a bunny dealer for the paid 'Special Game'
受付.register: polite keigo (desu/masu) to customers, brittle and flustered underneath; parenthesised lines are inner monologue and drop the keigo entirely
受付.note: NAME BOX label — must stay short. Her profile: took the job without realising it was an adult venue, agreed only on condition she never wears a bunny suit; self-conscious about her big butt; wary of men after being groped on a train; can't refuse a direct request; needs the money for rent and student loans.

受付ちゃん.role: the heroine's fan-nickname and later her porn-star stage name ('No.1女優 受付ちゃん')
受付ちゃん.note: Distinct from the bare 受付 name-box label on purpose: keep -chan wherever the source has it, because it is used as a brand/idol name.

支配人.role: the casino's manager — hammy showman who pushes the heroine into the bunny-dealer role and runs the broadcast
支配人.register: loud, theatrical, over-familiar; catchphrase コラコラコラ～ッ！！！ → 'Now now nooow!!!'; calls her この娘 / 受付ちゃん
支配人.note: Also appears as the announcer voice in the Hscene CSV's Announce column.

おじさん.role: the player character and, in the crowd scenes, the generic older male patrons
おじさん.note: Where the source clearly means the crowd rather than the player, 'the old guys' / 'the geezers' reads better than the literal 'uncle'.

出禁おじ.role: a patron who has been barred from the venue

バニー.role: the bunny dealers, and the heroine's bunny persona
バニー.note: NAME BOX label. バニーちゃん → 'Bunny-chan'; バニーディーラー → 'Bunny Dealer'.

おっとりちゃん.role: guest character — the gentle, dozy one

ギャルちゃん.register: brash gyaru slang; -ssu, ちょ〜, マジ

クールちゃん.role: guest character — the cool, aloof one

ヤンデレちゃん.register: sweet on the surface, possessive and unhinged underneath

実況アナウンサー.role: the live-broadcast play-by-play voice over the H-scenes (the Hscene CSV's Announce column) — the Manager working the crowd
実況アナウンサー.register: TV hype-man: shouty, delighted, crude, addresses the audience directly ('folks', 'ladies and gentlemen'), never the heroine's voice
実況アナウンサー.note: Not a name-box label — this speaker tag exists only to keep the narrator's register separate from the heroine's.
